data.title: NIRON MAGNETICS RECEIVES CONDITIONAL $150 MILLION DEPARTMENT OF WAR COMMITMENT
data.description: Niron Magnetics is set to receive financial support of around $150 million for the construction and equipment of their manufacturing plant in Sartell, Minnesota. The plant will specialize in producing Rare-earth-free Iron Nitride magnets, which do not rely on scarce rare earth materials. This innovative technology paves the way for a fresh method in domestic magnet manufacturing. The funding includes a 20-year direct loan commitment, indicating a significant long-term investment in this venture.

data.title: THOUSANDS OF CONTRA COSTA COUNTY TEAMSTERS SET STRIKE DATE
data.description: More than 2,000 employees of Contra Costa County are currently looking to negotiate cost of living adjustments in mediation.
